responsibility: Provides the core trait-resolution data model for rustc_infer by defining obligations and obligation collections, constructors and helpers for propagating causes and recursion depth, and the module’s public re-exports of trait-engine and projection-cache types.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the many `infer/*/mod.rs` files, this top-level `traits` `mod.rs` is the crate’s trait-resolution data-model hub. It defines `Obligation` and related aliases/helpers and reexports engine and projection-cache types, while the inference modules center on unification, region solving, snapshots, and other `InferCtxt` mechanics.
